verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an MCP server and a CLI that agents use to drive Summer Engine, but those are separate MCP and CLI capabilities. Nothing shows a documented public API (such as REST/HTTP endpoints) that programmatic consumers can call, and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe path returned 404. MCP and CLI interfaces count only as adjacent support for this story, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
